requirements.requirement: The system must invoke the relevance scoring logic for each clinical trial returned by the clinical_trials_service.
The system must attach a normalized relevance_score field to every trial object in the service response.
The system must preserve all existing trial fields and structure when adding the relevance_score field.
The system must ensure relevance_score values are within the normalized range defined in EVAL-CT-REL-001.
The system must integrate scoring without altering existing filtering logic or filtering outcomes.
The system must return trials even if relevance scoring is not available, provided the base retrieval succeeds.
The system must assign a default relevance_score value when scoring logic returns null or undefined.
The system must log an error event when relevance scoring fails for a trial without interrupting the response.
The system must ensure that relevance scoring uses the same user condition intent input used in the trial search request.
The system must process relevance scoring deterministically for identical inputs within a single request.
The system must not reorder trials unless explicitly configured to sort by relevance_score.
The system must ensure scoring execution does not exceed acceptable latency thresholds for the clinical_trials_service response.
The system must include contributing_factors from the scoring logic in each trial object when available.
The system must gracefully handle empty trial result sets without invoking relevance scoring.
The system must ensure compatibility with downstream facade contracts by maintaining response schema consistency after enrichment.
